# openwrt_sys_modules (Resource)

Manages kernel modules to load at boot time on OpenWrt device. Creates entries in /etc/modules.d/.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `modules` (List of String) List of kernel module names to load at boot (e.g., ['ath10k_pci', 'ath10k_core']).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID: sys_modules.
